dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Steelers (6-4) Week 12 Briefing: Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of Broncos
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Pittsburgh opened G Gennings Dunker's 21-day IR practice window alongside limited work for LB Nick Herbig (hip / ribs). LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) and WR Ben Skowronek (calf) did not practice Wednesday, while G Gennings Dunker (knee) and WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot (plantar fasciitis)) practiced in full [Joey Bray](https://www.behindthesteelcurtain.com/pittsburgh-steelers-news/178549/aaron-rodgers-says-he-wont-return-to-steelers).

Week 12 Broncos Outlook: Mike McCarthy and DC Patrick Graham open installation for the Denver Broncos (8-2, DEN -3.5, HC Sean Payton, OC Davis Webb & DC Vance Joseph (Acrisure Stadium)) as Pittsburgh prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [Tom Pelissero](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3116407/mason-rudolph#:~:text=Rudolph%20will%20start%20Friday's%20game%20against%20the).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 6-4 (2nd in AFC North • #7 Seed in AFC), Pittsburgh carries a 69.5% postseason projection, 12.1% AFC North division title mark, and 0.3% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Ryland Bickley](https://www.behindthesteelcurtain.com/pittsburgh-steelers-news/178560/steelers-expected-to-release-qb-aaron-rodgers-mike-mccarthy-pat-mcafee-show-broncos-benching).

Around the Beat: The Pittsburgh Steelers announced late Tuesday night that they had benched Aaron Rodgers [Joey Bray](https://www.behindthesteelcurtain.com/pittsburgh-steelers-news/178549/aaron-rodgers-says-he-wont-return-to-steelers).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Pittsburgh ranks #22 in Points / Game (21.4), #7 in Points Allowed / Game (20.1), #6 in Turnover Differential (+6), giving Mike McCarthy and Patrick Graham a clear benchmark ahead of Fri, Nov 27, 3:00 PM EST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Denver Broncos [Jordan Schultz](https://x.com/Schultz_Report/status/2125591675552841813).
